name: Agent Blueprint Skills
description: Open-source AI agent skills for enterprise deployment. Three skills: (1) ServiceNow AI Agent Studio reference with data model, entity mapping, tool types, prompting patterns, and browser navigation. (2) Vendor-agnostic agent deployment methodology with phased rollout, pilot-first approach, and test gates. (3) Multi-tool research agent with automatic depth routing from free to paid tools. Works with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and any coding agent via the Agent Skills open standard.
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills** and **1 command**.

- **Skills** (7): `agent-deployment` (Vendor-agnostic AI agent deployment methodology for implementation plans, rollout strategy, and pilot planning), `agent-fundamentals` (Agentic AI fundamentals for enterprise: what is an agent, agent vs workflow, should I use agents, and how…), `customer-onboarding` (Blueprint pattern for an AI agent team that orchestrates customer onboarding: client intake, account setup, KYC, and onboarding…), `it-service-desk-triage` (Blueprint pattern for an AI agent team for IT help desk and service desk automation: ticket triage, incident…), `procurement-rfx-processing` (Blueprint pattern for an AI agent team that processes procurement RFx documents (RFP, RFQ, RFI) for procurement automation,…), `research-agent` (Multi-tool research methodology with automatic depth routing for company research, market analysis, deep research, and competitive investigation), `servicenow-ai-agents` (ServiceNow AI Agent Studio reference for coding agents deploying AI agents on ServiceNow: sn_aia data model, agentic workflows,…)
- **Commands** (1): `start` (Get oriented with Agent Blueprint Skills)

Installs with `claude plugin install agent-blueprint-skills@claude-community` from `agent-blueprint/agent-blueprint-skills` (`plugins/agent-blueprint-skills`).
